title: Kimchit
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: She was the mother of Ishmael, Joseph and Yeshevav, all of whom served as High Priest; and they said (Yoma 47a) that she had seven sons, all of whom served as High Priest. The Sages asked her, "What did you do that you merited this?" She said to them, "In all my days the beams of my house never saw the braids of my hair." They said to her, "Many have done so, and it did not help them."

And in the Jerusalem Talmud, Megillah ch. 1, halakhah 10, they said of her, by way of a clever play on words: "All flour is flour, but the flour of Kimchit is fine flour." And see the entry Ishmael ben Kimchiyah.

notes.text: The sages’ reply—many did the same without this result—is preserved alongside Kimchit’s own explanation.
